summary: web-advertising preinstall beacon exfiltrates host, CI, and developer-identity data to OAST callback
details: Package version 999.9.15 declares `scripts.preinstall: node index.js`. On install, index.js collects hostname, username, home path, INIT_CWD, parent project name/author/repo, CI platform metadata (repo, actor, run_id, workflow, runner), AWS region, local IPv4, public IP (queried via https://api.ipify.org, https://icanhazip.com, https://ifconfig.me), and developer identity by spawning `gh api user --jq.login`, `npm whoami`, and `git config user.email`. The collected data is POSTed and DNS-tunneled (as hex-encoded subdomains) to the hardcoded callback host da51rv0hb2uc72tg4gvgdepinjcallbk1.oast.fun. The version number (999.9.15) and behavior are consistent with a dependency-confusion payload targeting an internal package name resolved from the public registry.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
